inj.note: The Saints opened Tyson's 21-day window in which to practice and potentially return from injured reserve Wednesday, and he managed three consecutive limited listings before getting a questionable tag for Week 9 action. The team still needs to officially activate Tyson from IR by 4:00 p.m. ET on Saturday in order for him to have a chance to play Sunday, but that appears as if it'll come to pass.

news.h: Saints' Jordyn Tyson and Kelvin Banks Jr. return to practice
news.d: Report on Jordyn Tyson and Kelvin Banks Jr. returning to Saints practice following the bye week.

news.h: Saints' Jordyn Tyson returns to practice, listed as limited participant
news.d: New Orleans Saints rookie wide receiver Jordyn Tyson took a major step toward making his season debut Wednesday, returning to practice for the first time since injuring his right hamstring in a joint practice against the Jacksonville Jaguars on Aug. 13.
